threads.body: [General] This entry publishes a Spring Integration test package as a nonexistent `opentelemetry` instrumentation with the scope `io.opentelemetry.opentelemetry`. `FileManager.isValidInstrumentationPath()` accepts the nested `version41Test/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent` directory as a module directory. Exclude source-tree package directories from module discovery and regenerate the catalog; deleting only this generated entry would let the next nightly run recreate it.
threads.hunk:
@@ -16482,6 +16403,10 @@ libraries:
         type: STRING
       - name: server.port
         type: LONG
+- name: opentelemetry
+  source_path: instrumentation/spring/spring-integration-4.1/library/src/version41Test/java/io/opentelemetry
+  scope:
+    name: io.opentelemetry.opentelemetry
